author: National Geographic
description:
While worker bees are busy gathering pollen and queens are laying eggs, drone bees are more single-minded, as Nat Geo Explorer-at-Large James Cameron and entomologist Dr. Sammy Ramsey discuss.

Narrated by Bertie Gregory, Secrets of the Bees is now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu.
